question: is the flagged path inert while the flag is at its default?

verdict.reason: closed state reproduces the pre-edit forward bit for bit

disclosures: candidate_sha_v2 covers the graph contract, the declared parameter shapes and the decode-rule table; source file hashes are recorded but are not part of it, so the edited living_core.py necessarily changes its own source hash while the identity hash must not move.
the baseline arrays were captured before taiji/ was edited; the comparison is against those bytes, not against a second run of the same edited code.

criteria.C1_default_off: LivingCoreConfig() reports sc_sfk_enabled is False and no code path other than the single flag branch at the entry of attach_store/clear_store/addressed_read/addressed_write can be taken; there is no half-open branch mixing the two paths.
criteria.C2_closed_bit_identical: with the flag off, the returned fast bytes and the post-read probabilities of all 176 readings, the store signature, the parameter table digest, state_bytes and candidate_sha_v2 are identical to the pre-change baseline: max|delta| = 0 exactly.
criteria.C3_zero_new_parameters: parameter tensor count, parameter element count and the full state_dict digest are unchanged; the address table is pure Python and holds no tensor.
criteria.C4_open_self_read: after the wired write path, each of the 22 written faces resolves, read back from its own store key (the raw bytes), to the address it was written at.
criteria.C5_open_reproduces_runner_side: paraphrase >= 20/22 AND unwritten >= 60/66 AND new_token no_match >= 20/22 AND no_value ambiguous >= 20/22
criteria.C6_open_write_side: growth starts at 2, expands at least three times, reaches >= 16; 23 distinct addresses; evictions = 0, silent overwrites = 0, rollbacks = 0; the conflicting two-item batch is rejected whole and the table is unchanged afterwards.
criteria.V_wire_not_neutral: any closed-state bit, parameter, state-bytes, identity or store-signature difference: hard failure, report store_addressing_wire_not_neutral and stop.
criteria.V_wired: closed passes and C4/C5/C6 hold: store_addressing_wired.
criteria.V_wired_regression: closed passes but at least one measurable open-state class is below its threshold or a write-side counter degrades: store_addressing_wired_regression with the degraded facet and its cause listed per class. The words 'basically the same' are not a verdict.
criteria.V_inconclusive: closed passes but the open-state reading cannot be compared (missing runner-side reference or an empty class): inconclusive, distribution only.
criteria.unchanged: no fixture, class, span, position or threshold is retuned after the first reading
